question: One atmosphere is equal to _____.
solution:
The correct answer is __**1.01 × 10⁵ Pa**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• One atmosphere (1 atm) is defined as being precisely equal to 101,325 Pa (Pascals).
 
• For practical purposes, it is commonly approximated as 1.01 × 10⁵ Pa.
 
• This unit of pressure is widely used in various fields, including physics, chemistry, and engineering.
 
• The value of 1 atm is derived from the average atmospheric pressure at sea level on Earth.
 
• It serves as a standard reference for pressure measurements and calculations.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Pascal (Pa):**

 
 
• The SI unit of pressure, equivalent to one newton per square meter.
 
 
 
• **Bar:**
 
 
• Another unit of pressure, where 1 bar = 100,000 Pa, slightly less than 1 atm.
 
 
 
• **Standard Atmospheric Pressure:**
 
 
• Often used in aviation, meteorology, and other fields to denote the pressure at sea level, defined as 101,325 Pa.
 
 
 
• **Pressure Conversion:**
 
 
• 1 atm = 1013.25 millibars (mbar)
 
• 1 atm = 760 mmHg (Torr)
 
• 1 atm = 14.696 psi (pounds per square inch)
